dict.string: Z-RO Cowork uses your camera when you turn on the Webcam mode in the Coworker screen so Zee can see what you're working on.
Z-RO Cowork uses your microphone when you turn on the Talk mode in the Coworker screen so Zee can hear you and respond.
Z-RO Cowork captures your screen when you turn on the Share Screen mode in the Coworker screen so Zee can see what's on your display.
Z-RO Cowork reads UI context from apps so Zee can understand what you're working on and guide you.
